name: Dragon Drop
summary:
**No controllers. No limits. Just you and your dragon.**

Dragon Drop is a VR adventure built for hand tracking first - soar across a world of floating islands using nothing but your bare hands.

*This isn't a dragon game with VR added. This is VR built around the dragon from the ground up.*
